verses.original: שִׁ֣ירוּ לַ֭יהוָה שִׁ֣יר חָדָ֑שׁ שִׁ֥ירוּ לַ֝יהוָ֗ה כָּל־ הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.transliteration: šî·rū Yah·weh šîr ḥā·ḏāš šî·rū Yah·weh kāl- hā·’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: Sing to the LORD a new song sing to the LORD all the earth
verses.literalPt: Cantai a Jeová um cântico novo, cantai a Jeová, todas as terras.

verses.original: שִׁ֣ירוּ לַ֭יהוָה בָּרֲכ֣וּ שְׁמ֑וֹ בַּשְּׂר֥וּ מִיּֽוֹם־ לְ֝י֗וֹם יְשׁוּעָתֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: šî·rū Yah·weh bā·ră·ḵū šə·mōw baś·śə·rū mî·yō·wm- lə·yō·wm yə·šū·‘ā·ṯōw
verses.literal: Sing to the LORD bless His name proclaim His salvation day after day
verses.literalPt: Cantai a Jeová, bendizei o seu nome; proclamai, de dia em dia, as boas novas da sua salvação.

verses.original: סַפְּר֣וּ בַגּוֹיִ֣ם כְּבוֹד֑וֹ בְּכָל־ הָֽ֝עַמִּ֗ים נִפְלְאוֹתָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: sap·pə·rū ḇag·gō·w·yim kə·ḇō·w·ḏōw bə·ḵāl hā·‘am·mîm nip̄·lə·’ō·w·ṯāw
verses.literal: Declare His glory among the nations His wonders among all peoples
verses.literalPt: Anunciai entre as nações a sua glória, entre todos os povos, as suas maravilhas,

verses.original: כִּ֥י גָ֘ד֤וֹל יְהוָ֣ה וּמְהֻלָּ֣ל מְאֹ֑ד נוֹרָ֥א ה֝֗וּא עַל־ כָּל־ אֱלֹהִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: kî ḡā·ḏō·wl Yah·weh ū·mə·hul·lāl mə·’ōḏ nō·w·rā hū ‘al- kāl- ’ĕ·lō·hîm
verses.literal: For great is the LORD and greatly to be praised He is to be feared . . . above all gods
verses.literalPt: porque grande é Jeová e digno de ser louvado. Ele é mais temível do que todos os deuses.

verses.original: כִּ֤י׀ כָּל־ אֱלֹהֵ֣י הָעַמִּ֣ים אֱלִילִ֑ים וַֽ֝יהוָ֗ה שָׁמַ֥יִם עָשָֽׂה׃
verses.literal: For all the gods of the nations are idols but it is the LORD who made the heavens
verses.literalPt: Pois todos os deuses dos povos são ídolos; Jeová, porém, fez os céus.

verses.original: הוֹד־ וְהָדָ֥ר לְפָנָ֑יו עֹ֥ז וְ֝תִפְאֶ֗רֶת בְּמִקְדָּשֽׁוֹ׃
verses.literal: Splendor and majesty are before Him strength and beauty fill His sanctuary
verses.literalPt: Honra e majestade estão diante dele, força e formosura, no seu santuário.

verses.original: הָב֣וּ לַ֭יהוָה מִשְׁפְּח֣וֹת עַמִּ֑ים הָב֥וּ לַ֝יהוָ֗ה כָּב֥וֹד וָעֹֽז׃
verses.transliteration: hā·ḇū Yah·weh miš·pə·ḥō·wṯ ‘am·mîm hā·ḇū Yah·weh kā·ḇō·wḏ wā·‘ōz
verses.literal: Ascribe to the LORD O families of the nations ascribe to the LORD glory and strength
verses.literalPt: Tributai a Jeová, famílias dos povos, tributai a Jeová, glória e força.

verses.original: הָב֣וּ לַ֭יהוָה כְּב֣וֹד שְׁמ֑וֹ שְׂאֽוּ־ מִ֝נְחָ֗ה וּבֹ֥אוּ לְחַצְרוֹתָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: hā·ḇū Yah·weh kə·ḇō·wḏ šə·mōw śə·’ū- min·ḥāh ū·ḇō·’ū lə·ḥaṣ·rō·w·ṯāw
verses.literal: Ascribe to the LORD the glory due His name bring an offering and enter His courts
verses.literalPt: Tributai a Jeová a glória devida ao seu nome; trazei oferendas e entrai nos seus átrios.

verses.original: הִשְׁתַּחֲו֣וּ לַ֭יהוָה בְּהַדְרַת־ קֹ֑דֶשׁ חִ֥ילוּ מִ֝פָּנָ֗יו כָּל־ הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.transliteration: hiš·ta·ḥă·wū Yah·weh bə·haḏ·raṯ- qō·ḏeš ḥî·lū mip·pā·nāw kāl- hā·’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: Worship the LORD in the splendor of His holiness tremble before Him all the earth
verses.literalPt: Adorai a Jeová, vestidos de sagrados ornamentos; tremei diante dele, todas as terras.

verses.original: אִמְר֤וּ בַגּוֹיִ֨ם׀ יְה֘וָ֤ה מָלָ֗ךְ אַף־ תִּכּ֣וֹן תֵּ֭בֵל בַּל־ תִּמּ֑וֹט יָדִ֥ין עַ֝מִּ֗ים בְּמֵישָׁרִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: ’im·rū ḇag·gō·w·yim Yah·weh mā·lāḵ ’ap̄- tik·kō·wn tê·ḇêl bal- tim·mō·wṭ yā·ḏîn ‘am·mîm bə·mê·šā·rîm
verses.literal: Declare among the nations The LORD reigns . . . The world is firmly established it cannot be moved He will judge the peoples with equity
verses.literalPt: Dizei entre as nações: Jeová é Rei. Também o mundo está estabelecido, de modo que não pode ser abalado. Ele julgará os povos com equidade.

verses.original: יִשְׂמְח֣וּ הַ֭שָּׁמַיִם וְתָגֵ֣ל הָאָ֑רֶץ יִֽרְעַ֥ם הַ֝יָּ֗ם וּמְלֹאֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: yiś·mə·ḥū haš·šā·ma·yim wə·ṯā·ḡêl hā·’ā·reṣ yir·‘am hay·yām ū·mə·lō·’ōw
verses.literal: Let the heavens be glad and the earth rejoice let the sea resound and all that fills it
verses.literalPt: Alegrem-se os céus, e regozije-se a terra; brame o mar e a sua plenitude.

verses.original: יַעֲלֹ֣ז שָׂ֭דַי וְכָל־ אֲשֶׁר־ בּ֑וֹ אָ֥ז יְ֝רַנְּנ֗וּ כָּל־ עֲצֵי־ יָֽעַר׃
verses.transliteration: ya·‘ă·lōz śā·d̲ai wə·ḵāl ’ă·šer- bōw ’āz yə·ran·nə·nū kāl- ‘ă·ṣê- yā·‘ar
verses.literal: Let the fields exult and all that is in them Then all the trees of the forest will sing for joy
verses.literalPt: Exulte o campo, e quanto nele há. Então, cantarão de júbilo todas as árvores do bosque

verses.original: לִפְנֵ֤י יְהוָ֨ה׀ כִּ֬י בָ֗א כִּ֥י בָא֮ לִשְׁפֹּ֪ט הָ֫אָ֥רֶץ יִשְׁפֹּֽט־ תֵּבֵ֥ל בְּצֶ֑דֶק וְ֝עַמִּ֗ים בֶּאֱמוּנָתֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: lip̄·nê Yah·weh kî ḇā kî ḇā liš·pōṭ hā·’ā·reṣ yiš·pōṭ- tê·ḇêl bə·ṣe·ḏeq wə·‘am·mîm be·’ĕ·mū·nā·ṯōw
verses.literal: before the LORD for He is coming He is coming to judge the earth He will judge the world in righteousness and the peoples in His faithfulness
verses.literalPt: ante a face de Jeová, porque ele vem, porque vem a julgar a terra. Ele julgará o mundo com justiça e os povos, com a sua fidelidade.
